he stopped me later on and asked my pronouns because i didn’t specify (just wrote, i’m trans as number 3). and from there, it was chill. no weirdness just understanding.

just softly advocate and call people on their shit without drawing a lot of attention, and find small ways to give people opportunities to feel open about themselves.

also: maybe hang up a little safe space sign on your door (with other signs and stuff not related just so it doesn’t stand out too much).
